claims.statement: The Eastern Han ruled from Luoyang, east of the earlier capital at Chang’an. Two large palace complexes dominated the city. Caravans and visiting envoys connected the capital with places beyond the empire.
Luoyang under the Eastern Han: 25 CE to 220 CE. Eastern Han study window, not the foundation or end of the city. Precise geographic reference not yet checked.
Eastern Han–Northern Wei Luoyang site reference. This point locates the existing study window; it does not date every structure, define the city’s boundaries or establish any person’s presence.
